name: SMHI
freeEvidence: Official SMHI open-data service permits keyless read access; station metadata keeps the response small.

name: Disify
freeEvidence: Basic public email-validation endpoint is free and keyless; synthetic example.com address only.

name: Ocean Biogeographic
freeEvidence: Official data policy makes data freely accessible to any user; API is intended for small subsets. Preserve dataset attribution and licence metadata.

name: OpenLEI API
freeEvidence: GLEIF Access Service is free and its legal-entity reference data are provided under CC0.

name: National Bank of Poland
freeEvidence: Official public central-bank exchange-rate API documents keyless HTTPS GET access to published data.

name: SunriseSunset.io
freeEvidence: Official documentation explicitly says free, no key, no signup, GET only. A link back to sunrisesunset.io is required.

name: Wandbox
freeEvidence: Official service FAQ permits educational and commercial use with per-IP limits and no SLA. Only public compiler metadata is read; no code is executed.

name: NetworkCalc
freeEvidence: Official site says APIs are free and no account is required; docs distinguish public core lookups from authenticated account APIs.

name: ViaCEP
freeEvidence: Official documentation describes a free postal-code webservice with keyless JSON/XML examples; avoid mass validation or bulk database downloads.

name: Wolne Lektury
freeEvidence: Official library provides public JSON metadata API; metadata read has no authentication or tariff. Respect linked publication-specific licences and source attribution.

name: PRH Finland
freeEvidence: Official PRH open data is free of charge and may be used in services; attribute PRH/YTJ as source and do not imply official endorsement.

name: Wger Workout Manager
freeEvidence: Official documentation permits public exercise and ingredient reads without authentication; private user routines require login. Free hosted software and public data; exercise content requires CC-BY-SA attribution/share-alike where applicable.

name: Squiggle
freeEvidence: Official requirements explicitly allow free commercial use. Set identifiable User-Agent with public contact email, cache results, avoid parallel/bulk polling and attribute prediction sources.

name: UniProt
freeEvidence: Official UniProt REST API provides public protein information without authentication; data uses CC BY 4.0. Explicit .json response and accession-only fields keep this lookup small.
